snippet.title: bacrush - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Bacrush is a fast-paced arcade game where you control a small green square. Your goal is to collect as many coins as possible while dodging dangerous gray cubes. You can shoot projectiles to push back the cubes, but be careful — shooting too much will cause your square to overheat! Gather as many coins as you can and survive as long as possible to set a new high score.

Developed by Xitilon

#ps4 #playstation4 #xitilon #bacrush #theforeseenarcade
